WebSocket API (WebSockets)
Note:
This feature is available in
Web Workers
.
The
WebSocket API
makes it possible to open a two-way interactive communication session between the user's browser and a server. With this API, you can send messages to a server and receive responses without having to poll the server for a reply.
The WebSocket API provides two alternative mechanisms for creating and using web socket connections: the
WebSocket
interface and the
WebSocketStream
interface.
The
WebSocket
interface is stable and has good browser and server support. However it doesn't support
backpressure
. As a result, when messages arrive faster than the application can process them it will either fill up the device's memory by buffering those messages, become unresponsive due to 100% CPU usage, or bot
